title: [Sprint] Slow Invoice Loading
description:
**Why this matters:** Users say the invoice list/dashboard is slow to load.

Raised in **7 pieces of user feedback**, representing an estimated **280 users**. RICE score **420**.

**What users said:**
> Loading my invoices takes forever. The dashboard spins for like 20 seconds every time I open it.  
> — _support_ticket_
> App is decent but SO slow when I have a lot of invoices. Please optimize the loading speed.  
> — _app_review_
> Anyone else seeing the invoice list take ages to load? It's painful with 200+ invoices.  
> — _slack_

**Definition of done:** the pain point above is resolved and verified with the users who reported it.

title: [Sprint] Recurring Invoices
description:
**Why this matters:** Users want invoices that repeat/auto-send on a schedule.

Raised in **6 pieces of user feedback**, representing an estimated **240 users**. RICE score **180**.

**What users said:**
> Why can't I set up a recurring invoice? I bill the same clients every month and have to redo it manually each time.  
> — _support_ticket_
> Needs recurring/repeating invoices badly. I send identical monthly bills and Billy makes me start over every time.  
> — _app_review_
> Is there a way to schedule an invoice to auto-send every month? Recurring billing would save me hours.  
> — _slack_

**Definition of done:** the pain point above is resolved and verified with the users who reported it.
